summary:
This critique is partial and short of what the brief asked for. I ran two greps and nothing else: no web fetches, no probes, and no check of the judge's Baseline or version numbers.

What the greps confirmed:
- The judge's citation `_reboot.scss:582` (`output { display: inline-block }`) is correct.
- Bootstrap 5.3 has a skip-link helper, `.visually-hidden-focusable` (/home/user/veneer/node_modules/bootstrap/scss/helpers/_visually-hidden.scss:6). Skip links are therefore overlap and cannot be a native candidate. The judge did not list them.

What the judge left out, from the brief's own list:
- Combobox and autocomplete are absent from all three lists. Bootstrap has no combobox component, but I did not read enough to rule on whether it overlaps with Bootstrap's datalist or dropdown.
- Tree view, steppers, tags input, split-pane resizing, virtualized lists, and relative time with Intl are also absent from all three lists. I did not check whether Bootstrap has a counterpart for any of them.

Nothing else is proven:
- No overlap verdict is shown wrong with Bootstrap documentation or source.
- No support claim is shown contradicted.
